description:
Downloads the proteome of a bacterial assembly from NCBI, annotates it with eggNOG-mapper and summarises the annotation in an interactive Eggsplorer report.

## Associated Tutorial

This workflows is part of the tutorial [Functional profiling of a bacterial genome with Eggsplorer](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/genome-annotation/tutorials/eggsplorer/tutorial.html), available in the [GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org)

## Features

* Includes [Galaxy Workflow Tests](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/faqs/gtn/gtn_workflow_testing.html)
* Includes a [Galaxy Workflow Report](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/faqs/galaxy/workflows_report_view.html)
